verdict.rationale: Pipedream documents concrete adapters for the Vercel AI SDK (dedicated 'ai-frameworks' docs page, code example loading tools, chat app demo) and a native Claude/Anthropic Messages API MCP connector, plus generic 'point any MCP client' compatibility. However, the evidence never names LangChain, CrewAI, or an OpenAI SDK-specific adapter, so the story's broader framework list is only partly covered. Missing for 10: explicit documented adapters/examples for LangChain, CrewAI, and OpenAI SDK.
